verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents Notebooks as a web-based Jupyter IDE, which covers the Jupyter half of the story. IDE connectivity relies only on generic SSH access to machines, and one hands-on user reports that getting SSH access on Core VMs was an uphill battle, which undercuts the 'one step' claim. Missing for 10: any documented one-click VS Code/Cursor integration, evidence that Jupyter opens in one step on a Machine (not just the separate Notebooks product), and independent corroboration of smooth connectivity.
